title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
title_zh: 探索生成式图像水印在潜在频率掩蔽下的弱点

paragraphs.en: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. These results identify latent-frequency manipulation as a practical attack surface and highlight the need to include such attacks in robustness evaluations of generative image watermarking.
paragraphs.zh: 隐形水印已成为追踪人工智能生成图像的核心工具，但其对自适应移除攻击的鲁棒性仍是一个未解决的安全问题。 我们提出了一种名为“潜在频率掩码”的攻击方法，通过替换带水印图像潜在表示中选择的傅里叶系数来消除水印证据。 为提升效率，替换值可从高斯噪声中采样；若需更好地保留图像质量，则可从扩散再生过程中获取。 我们提供了一个理论失真界限，用于描述重构后的对抗性图像与掩码后的潜在频率扰动之间的变化关系。 我们在基于 DiffusionDB 和 MS-COCO 提示生成的图像上，对六种扩散水印方法评估了所提出的攻击方法。 “潜在频率掩码”能够移除或显著削弱多种水印，同时保持感知质量，并相比现有攻击方法实现了更优的运行时间。 这些结果表明，潜在频率操控是一种可行的攻击面，并凸显了在生成式图像水印的鲁棒性评估中纳入此类攻击的必要性。

paragraphs.en: The rapid advancement of generative AI has started a new era of photorealistic image synthesis. Modern diffusion-based and autoregressive models can produce images of remarkable quality, making it difficult to distinguish synthetic content from authentic photographs. While these capabilities unlock significant creative and commercial potential, they also create critical societal challenges: preventing AI-generated misinformation, deepfakes, and fabricated visual content.

paragraphs.en: Detecting generated images through empirical classifiers has proven insufficient — such models tend to overfit to the artifacts of specific generators and fail to generalize to unseen architectures [ 1 ] . As a result, digital watermarking has emerged as the main paradigm for tracking AI-generated content: embedded imperceptible marks at the time of generation can later indicate which generation model has been used and even the exact user session. The urgency of this approach has been recognized at the policy level [ 2 ] : the EU and China now mandate detectable marking of AI outputs, while the US is moving toward similar requirements through state law and proposed federal legislation.
paragraphs.zh: 通过经验分类器检测生成图像已被证明是不足的——这类模型往往会对特定生成器的特征产生过拟合，而无法推广到未见的架构 [ 1 ]。 因此，数字水印已成为追踪人工智能生成内容的主要方法：在生成时嵌入的不可察觉标记，后续可以表明使用了哪种生成模型，甚至能识别出具体的用户会话。 政策层面已认识到这一方法的紧迫性 [ 2 ]：欧盟和中国目前要求对人工智能输出进行可检测的标记，而美国则通过州法律和拟议的联邦立法逐步推行类似要求。

paragraphs.en: The practical security of watermarking schemes remains an open question. As new watermarking methods are proposed, new attacks are designed to remove or corrupt the embedded signal. Figure 1 illustrates this setting: a provider embeds an imperceptible watermark at generation time, after which an adversary may attempt to erase it before publication, while a verifier seeks to recover the mark from the published image. A substantial body of work has examined the vulnerability of spatial-domain and learning-based watermarks; however, one class of methods has received comparatively little scrutiny: frequency-based watermarking schemes that encode information in an image’s spectral representation.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we expose a previously unreported vulnerability in this family of methods. We demonstrate that frequency-domain watermarks can be systematically removed via an adversarial attack that remains visually imperceptible, preserving image quality while fully neutralizing the embedded signal. To our knowledge, we are the first to systematically exploit latent-frequency masking against this class. We further discuss potential defense strategies and analyze their trade-offs. Our main contributions are as follows:

paragraphs.en: We identify and formalize a novel attack surface in generative image watermarking: the latent-frequency representation obtained by applying the Fourier transform to a diffusion model’s VAE latent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别并形式化地定义了生成式图像水印技术中一种新的攻击面：即对扩散模型的 VAE 潜在变量应用傅里叶变换后得到的潜在频率表示。

paragraphs.en: We propose Latent Frequency Masking (LFM) , a gradient-free removal attack that suppresses watermark evidence by replacing selected latent-frequency coefficients, with two replacement strategies — efficient Gaussian sampling and image-adaptive diffusion regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种名为潜在频率掩码（Latent Frequency Masking，LFM）的无梯度移除攻击方法。该方法通过替换选定的潜在频率系数来抑制水印证据，并采用了两种替换策略——高效高斯采样和图像自适应扩散再生。

paragraphs.en: We derive a distortion bound relating the pixel-space change to the VAE reconstruction error and the masked latent-frequency perturbation, characterizing the quality–removal trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推导出了一个失真界限，该界限将像素空间的变化与 VAE 重建误差和掩码潜在频率扰动联系起来，从而描述了质量与移除之间的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: We conduct extensive experiments against six diffusion watermarking schemes on DiffusionDB and MS-COCO, showing that LFM removes or substantially weakens most while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime, and we analyze why distributed embedding (e.g., Gaussian Shading) resists it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 DiffusionDB 和 MS-COCO 数据集上对六种扩散水印方案进行了广泛实验，结果表明 LFM 能够移除或显著削弱大多数水印，同时保持感知质量并实现良好的运行时间；此外，我们还分析了分布式嵌入（例如高斯阴影）为何能抵抗 LFM。

sents.en: Digital image watermarking techniques can be categorized by the stage at which the watermark is embedded.

sents.en: The following classification of methods is proposed:
sents.zh: 以下提出了一种方法的分类：

paragraphs.en: post-generation methods, which apply a watermark to already generated or captured images.
paragraphs.zh: 生成后方法，即对已经生成或捕获的图像应用水印。

paragraphs.en: in-generation methods, which integrate the watermark directly into the image creation process,
paragraphs.zh: 生成内方法，这些方法将水印直接整合到图像生成过程中，

paragraphs.en: Post-generation methods , which are applied to already existing images, traditionally operate in the spatial, discrete cosine, Fourier, or wavelet domains. These methods embed watermarks into selected frequency coefficients [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Contemporary neural methods adhere to the ’encoder — noise layer — decoder’ architecture pioneered by HiDDeN [ 6 ] , frequently incorporating invertible networks [ 7 ] , adversarial training, and attention mechanisms to enhance imperceptibility and robustness [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . To demonstrate resilience against geometric attacks, recent works also explore multi-region embedding [ 12 , 13 ] and synchronization patterns [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 后处理生成方法应用于已存在的图像，传统上在空间域、离散余弦变换域、傅里叶变换域或小波变换域中操作。 这些方法将水印嵌入到选定的频率系数中 [3, 4, 5]。 当前的神经方法遵循由 HiDDeN [6] 开创的“编码器—噪声层—解码器”架构，并经常结合可逆网络 [7]、对抗性训练和注意力机制，以增强不可察觉性和鲁棒性 [8, 9, 10, 11]。 为了展示对几何攻击的抵抗力，近期的研究还探索了多区域嵌入 [12, 13] 和同步模式 [14]。

paragraphs.en: Tree-Ring [ 15 ] embeds a structured ring-shaped pattern in the frequency domain of the initial noise, achieving strong robustness to geometric transformations. Subsequent works [ 16 , 17 ] extended this idea with discretized ring patterns and multi-bit encoding. MaXsive [ 18 ] injects a structured X-shaped template into the latent noise to enable geometric alignment, while encoding the watermark message in separate latent components. Gaussian Shading [ 19 ] preserves the statistical properties of the noise and embeds the watermark by modulating latent variables according to predefined quantile intervals of the normal distribution. Stable Signature [ 20 ] adopts a different strategy by fine-tuning the generative model itself, specifically the VAE decoder, to imprint a watermark into the generated latent.
paragraphs.zh: Tree-Ring [ 15 ] 在初始噪声的频率域中嵌入一个结构化的环形模式，从而对几何变换表现出极强的鲁棒性。 后续研究 [ 16 , 17 ] 通过离散化环形模式和多位编码扩展了这一思路。 MaXsive [ 18 ] 将结构化的 X 形模板注入潜在噪声以实现几何对齐，同时将水印消息编码到独立的潜在组件中。 Gaussian Shading [ 19 ] 保留了噪声的统计特性，并通过根据正态分布的预定义分位数区间调节潜在变量来嵌入水印。 Stable Signature [ 20 ] 采用不同策略，即对生成模型本身（特别是 VAE 解码器）进行微调，从而在生成的潜在表示中刻录水印。

paragraphs.en: Compared with post-generation watermarks, in-generation methods offer several practical advantages that motivate our focus. By weaving the mark into the sampling trajectory rather than adding it afterward, several designs achieve minimal perceptual degradation — e.g., Gaussian Shading [ 19 ] is provably distribution-preserving — while exhibiting markedly stronger robustness to conventional distortions than spatial-domain post-hoc schemes; standardized stress tests [ 21 ] confirm that methods like Tree-Ring [ 15 ] withstand perturbations on which post-hoc watermarks usually fail. This combination of quality and resilience is precisely what makes their security against adaptive, watermark-aware removal an open and consequential question — the one we examine in this work.
paragraphs.zh: 与生成后水印相比，生成内方法具有若干实际优势，这促使我们将研究重点放在此类方法上。 通过将标记融入采样轨迹而非事后添加，一些设计实现了最小的感知退化——例如，高斯着色 [19] 已被证明能够保持分布不变——同时，在对抗传统失真方面表现出比空间域事后方案明显更强的鲁棒性；标准化的压力测试 [21] 证实，像树轮 [15] 这样的方法能够抵抗那些通常会导致事后水印失效的扰动。 正是这种质量与抗扰能力的结合，使得它们如何抵御针对水印的自适应移除这一问题成为一个开放且重要的研究课题——而这正是本研究要探讨的问题。

sents.en: Compared with post-generation watermarks, in-generation methods offer several practical advantages that motivate our focus.
sents.zh: 与生成后水印相比，生成内方法具有若干实际优势，这促使我们将研究重点放在此类方法上。

sents.en: By weaving the mark into the sampling trajectory rather than adding it afterward, several designs achieve minimal perceptual degradation — e.g., Gaussian Shading [ 19 ] is provably distribution-preserving — while exhibiting markedly stronger robustness to conventional distortions than spatial-domain post-hoc schemes; standardized stress tests [ 21 ] confirm that methods like Tree-Ring [ 15 ] withstand perturbations on which post-hoc watermarks usually fail.
sents.zh: 通过将标记融入采样轨迹而非事后添加，一些设计实现了最小的感知退化——例如，高斯着色 [19] 已被证明能够保持分布不变——同时，在对抗传统失真方面表现出比空间域事后方案明显更强的鲁棒性；标准化的压力测试 [21] 证实，像树轮 [15] 这样的方法能够抵抗那些通常会导致事后水印失效的扰动。

sents.en: This combination of quality and resilience is precisely what makes their security against adaptive, watermark-aware removal an open and consequential question — the one we examine in this work.
sents.zh: 正是这种质量与抗扰能力的结合，使得它们如何抵御针对水印的自适应移除这一问题成为一个开放且重要的研究课题——而这正是本研究要探讨的问题。

paragraphs.en: The robustness of watermarking schemes is determined not only by resistance to benign image distortions, but also by the strength of the attacker considered during evaluation. Standard perturbations such as JPEG compression, blur, noise, cropping, and geometric transforms remain necessary sanity checks, yet recent work shows that robustness to such distortions does not imply security against adaptive removal or forgery.
paragraphs.zh: 水印方案鲁棒性的决定因素不仅在于其对良性图像失真的抵抗力，还在于评估过程中所考虑攻击者的攻击强度。 JPEG 压缩、模糊、噪声、裁剪和几何变换等标准扰动仍然是必要的合理性检验，但近期研究指出，对这类失真的鲁棒性并不等同于能够抵御自适应移除或伪造攻击。

paragraphs.en: One line of work studies analytical attacks that estimate the watermark directly. Yang et al. [ 22 ] show that content-agnostic watermark patterns can often be recovered by averaging multiple watermarked images and subtracting the estimated pattern, and that this estimate may even enable forgery. A second major family comprises regeneration-based attacks. Zhao et al. [ 23 ] demonstrate that invisible watermarks can be removed by first perturbing an image and then reconstructing it with a generative prior, which motivates diffusion-based baselines such as Diffusion Regeneration and Diffusion Rinsing attacks used in our experiments. Related diffusion purification and model-substitution attacks were analyzed by Saberi et al. [ 24 ] . Liang et al. [ 25 ] further show that Deep Image Prior can serve as a competitive black-box baseline, while Alam et al. [ 26 ] improve the quality–removal trade-off with saliency-aware diffusion reconstruction (SADRE).
paragraphs.zh: 一类研究关注直接估计水印的分析性攻击。Yang 等人 [ 22 ] 指出，通过平均多张带水印的图像并减去估计出的模式，通常可以恢复出与内容无关的水印图案，而这种估计甚至可能促成伪造。 第二类主要攻击包括基于再生方法的攻击。Zhao 等人 [ 23 ] 证明，可以通过先扰动图像，再利用生成式先验重构图像来移除隐形水印，这启发我们实验中使用的扩散模型基础方法，例如 Diffusion Regeneration 和 Diffusion Rinsing 攻击。 Saberi 等人 [ 24 ] 分析了相关的扩散净化和模型替换攻击。Liang 等人 [ 25 ] 进一步表明，Deep Image Prior 可以作为一种具有竞争力的黑盒基础方法，而 Alam 等人 [ 26 ] 通过引入显著性感知的扩散重构（SADRE），改进了水印移除与图像质量之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work studies adaptive and optimization-based removal. Lukas et al. [ 27 ] formulate watermark evasion as an optimization problem and show that optimized attacks can substantially outperform fixed perturbation baselines. UnMarker [ 28 ] further argues that robust defensive watermarks necessarily rely on spectral carriers and introduces a universal spectral attack that succeeds without detector feedback, making it particularly relevant to frequency-based watermarking. Complementary work also considers model-level attacks: Hu et al. [ 29 ] show that decoder-rooted watermarks such as Stable Signature can be neutralized by fine-tuning the generator itself.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线关注自适应和基于优化的移除方法。Lukas 等人 [ 27 ] 将水印规避问题建模为优化问题，并证明经过优化的攻击能够显著超越固定扰动基线方法。 UnMarker [ 28 ] 进一步指出，稳健的防御性水印必然依赖光谱载体，并提出了一种通用光谱攻击方法，该方法无需检测器反馈即可成功实施，因此对基于频率的水印技术尤为重要。 补充研究也考虑了模型层面的攻击：Hu 等人 [ 29 ] 证明像 Stable Signature 这类基于解码器的水印可以通过微调生成器本身而被中和。

[ 31 ] demonstrate realistic black-box forgery and removal attacks for diffusion and post-hoc image watermarks, with the latter corresponding to the WMForger method in our experiments. Overall, current evidence suggests that watermark robustness should be assessed not only under conventional distortions but also against steganalytic, regenerative, adaptive, and forgery-oriented attacks.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-regeneration replacement. As an image-adaptive replacement strategy, we use diffusion regeneration to construct y ^ \hat{y} . paragraphs.en: The Lipschitz continuity of the decoder One of the assumptions in Theorem 1 is that the VAE decoder is Lipschitz continuous. This assumption is natural for the Stable Diffusion decoder used in our experiments. After its weights are fixed, the decoder is a deterministic map 𝒟 : ℝ H × W × C → ℝ H I × W I × 3 \mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{H_{I}\times W_{I}\times 3} implemented by a neural network. The network is built from convolutional and linear layers, pointwise activation functions, upsampling operations, residual connections, attention blocks, and normalization layers. The composition of Lipschitz maps is also Lipschitz, with a constant bounded by the product of the constituent constants (and by corresponding sums for residual branches). Therefore, if all the building blocks are Lipschitz under the Euclidean norm, then the decoder also admits some finite Lipschitz constant L L .
paragraphs.zh: 解码器的利普希茨连续性：定理 1 中的一个假设是 VAE 解码器具有利普希茨连续性。 对于我们在实验中使用的 Stable Diffusion 解码器而言，这一假设是合理的。 在权重固定之后，解码器是一个由神经网络实现的确定性映射 𝒟 : ℝ H × W × C → ℝ H I × W I × 3 \mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{H_{I}\times W_{I}\times 3}。 该网络由卷积层和线性层、逐点激活函数、上采样操作、残差连接、注意力模块和归一化层构成。 利普希茨映射的复合仍然是利普希茨的，其常数由组成常数的乘积（对于残差分支则由相应的和）所限定。 因此，如果所有构建模块在欧几里得范数下都是利普希茨的，那么解码器也存在某个有限的利普希茨常数 L L 。

paragraphs.en: Prior work gives bounds and estimation procedures for fully connected layers, convolutional layers, pooling layers, activation functions, normalization, and residual connections under ℓ 2 \ell_{2} , ℓ 1 \ell_{1} , and ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} norms [ 34 ] . For attention blocks, however, the situation is more complex: by itself, the standard dot-product self-attention is not globally Lipschitz for an unbounded input domain [ 35 ] . However, it can be shown that together with normalization layers, the combined map is Lipschitz. In particular, [ 36 ] proves that for inputs of length n n restricted to any compact set, self-attention has an explicit finite Lipschitz upper bound. In the considered architecture, GroupNorm is applied before the query, key, and value projections, and since GroupNorm normalizes each channel group using variance, its output is bounded. Hence, the attention module only receives inputs in a bounded set, and the bounded-domain Lipschitz result applies. The combined map is therefore Lipschitz with a constant obtained by composing the GroupNorm, attention, and residual constants.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作为全连接层、卷积层、池化层、激活函数、归一化和残差连接在 ℓ₂ \ell_{2}、ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 和 ℓ∞ \ell_{\infty} 范数下的界限和估计方法提供了理论依据 [34]。 然而，对于注意力模块，情况更为复杂：单独的标准化点积自注意力机制在输入域无界时并非全局利普希茨连续的 [35]。 不过，可以证明，当与归一化层结合使用时，组合映射是利普希茨连续的。 具体而言，[36] 证明了对于长度限制在任意紧集上的输入 n，自注意力具有一个明确的有限利普希茨上界。 在所考虑的架构中，GroupNorm 被应用于查询、键和值投影之前，并且由于 GroupNorm 使用方差对每个通道组进行归一化，其输出是有界的。 因此，注意力模块仅接收有界集合中的输入，从而可以应用有界域上的利普希茨连续性结论。 因此，该组合映射是利普希茨连续的，其常数可通过组合 GroupNorm、注意力和残差连接的常数得到。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate watermark erasing attacks from two perspectives: (i) how reliably the watermark can be removed using the given transformation, and (ii) how much this distortion affects the image quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个角度评估水印擦除攻击：(i) 使用给定的变换方法，能够多可靠地移除水印；以及 (ii) 这种失真对图像质量的影响有多大。

paragraphs.en: The first perspective concerns the reliability of watermark extraction. Reliability evaluation depends on whether a method embeds only a detectable signal or a full binary payload. In zero-bit watermarking, the detector decides whether a watermark is present, yielding a binary detection setting. Practical systems are usually expected to operate under strict false-alarm constraints; therefore, robustness is commonly summarized by the True Positive Rate achieved at a predefined low False Positive Rate, i.e., TPR@x%FPR, we use an FPR of 1%.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种观点涉及水印提取的可靠性。 可靠性评估取决于某种方法究竟是仅嵌入可检测的信号，还是嵌入完整的二进制有效载荷。 在零比特水印技术中，检测器会判断是否存在水印，从而形成一种二值检测设定。 实际系统通常需要在严格的误报约束条件下运行；因此，鲁棒性一般通过在前定义的较低误报率下实现的真正阳性率来概括，即 TPR@x%FPR，此处我们使用的 FPR 为 1%。

In settings where no clean reference is available, perceptual quality can instead be estimated with no-reference image quality metrics. To this end, we employ the popular CLIP-IQA [ 40 ] model.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose a novel attack on watermarks for diffusion-generated images. The method operates by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the VAE latent representation and supports Gaussian and diffusion-regeneration replacement strategies. By modifying only selected frequency coefficients of the VAE latent representation, Latent Frequency Masking can substantially reduce watermark detectability while preserving most of the visual content of the original image. The Gaussian replacement variant is particularly efficient, requiring only VAE encoding and decoding together with Fourier transforms. The diffusion-regeneration variant improves image quality in several settings by using an image-adaptive replacement latent, although its effectiveness depends on whether regeneration itself suppresses the target watermark.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种针对扩散生成图像水印的新攻击方法。 该方法通过替换 VAE 潜在表示中选择的傅里叶系数来运行，并支持高斯替换和扩散再生替换策略。 通过仅修改 VAE 潜在表示中选择的频率系数，潜在频率掩码可以显著降低水印的可检测性，同时保留原始图像的大部分视觉内容。 高斯替换变体尤其高效，仅需 VAE 编码和解码以及傅里叶变换。 扩散再生变体通过使用自适应图像的替换潜在变量，在多种设置下提升了图像质量，但其有效性取决于再生过程本身是否抑制了目标水印。

paragraphs.en: The experiments reveal that Tree-Ring, RingID, Stable Signature, MaXsive, and METR are vulnerable to Latent Frequency Masking under suitable mask and replacement parameters. In contrast, Gaussian Shading is significantly harder to remove with partial masking, which is consistent with its design: watermark information is distributed throughout the latent rather than concentrated in a localized spectral region. This suggests that localizing watermark information in predictable latent-frequency regions may create an exploitable weakness, while distributed embedding can improve resistance to this class of attacks.

sents.zh: 实验表明，在合适的掩码和替换参数下，Tree-Ring、RingID、Stable Signature、MaXsive 和 METR 都容易受到潜在频率掩码的攻击。

sents.en: In contrast, Gaussian Shading is significantly harder to remove with partial masking, which is consistent with its design: watermark information is distributed throughout the latent rather than concentrated in a localized spectral region.
sents.zh: 相比之下，高斯阴影在部分掩码的情况下要更难去除，这与它的设计一致：水印信息分布在整个潜在空间中，而不是集中在某个局部频谱区域。

sents.en: This suggests that localizing watermark information in predictable latent-frequency regions may create an exploitable weakness, while distributed embedding can improve resistance to this class of attacks.
sents.zh: 这表明，将水印信息定位在可预测的潜在频率区域可能会产生可利用的弱点，而分布式嵌入则能增强对此类攻击的抵抗力。

paragraphs.en: The proposed attack has several limitations. First, our mask selection procedure uses search over a small parameter space and therefore may not be optimal for an adversary with a very strict query budget. Second, the attack assumes access to a compatible latent diffusion autoencoder, which is realistic for many open generative pipelines but may not hold for proprietary systems. Finally, our theoretical bound characterizes the distortion introduced by the latent modification, but does not by itself guarantee watermark removal; removal depends on how each watermarking scheme stores and detects its signal.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的攻击存在若干局限性。 首先，我们的掩码选择过程通过搜索一个较小的参数空间来实现，因此对于查询预算极为严格的攻击者而言，可能并非最优方案。 其次，该攻击假设能够访问一个兼容的潜在扩散自编码器；尽管许多开放式的生成流程具备这一条件，但专有系统可能并不满足此前提。 最后，我们的理论界限描述了潜在修改所引入的失真，但本身并不能保证水印被移除；能否成功移除取决于每种水印方案存储和检测其信号的具体方式。

paragraphs.en: From a defensive perspective, the findings indicate that watermark evaluation should include latent-space and frequency-space attacks in addition to standard image distortions. Robust watermarking schemes should avoid placing most of the watermark evidence in compact, predictable latent-frequency regions. Promising directions include detector designs that remain sensitive after partial latent replacement, and training procedures that explicitly include Latent Frequency Masking as an adversarial transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 从防御角度来看，研究结果表明，水印评估除了标准的图像失真之外，还应包括潜在空间和频率空间的攻击。 稳健的水印方案应避免将大部分水印证据置于紧凑且可预测的潜在-频率区域中。 有前景的方向包括：在部分潜在空间被替换后仍能保持敏感度的检测器设计，以及明确将潜在频率掩码作为对抗性变换纳入的训练流程。

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, we introduced Latent Frequency Masking, a simple and efficient attack for evaluating the robustness of invisible watermarks in diffusion-generated images. Across multiple watermarking schemes, LFM achieves a favorable trade-off between watermark removal, perceptual quality, and computational cost, exposing weaknesses that are not captured by conventional robustness tests. We hope these results encourage stronger evaluation protocols and more robust watermark designs for generative image provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 总之，我们提出了潜在频率掩码（Latent Frequency Masking），这是一种简单而高效的攻击方法，用于评估扩散生成图像中不可见水印的鲁棒性。 在多种水印方案中，LFM 在水印移除、感知质量和计算成本之间实现了良好的权衡，揭示了传统鲁棒性测试未能检测到的弱点。 我们希望这些结果能够推动更严格的评估协议和更稳健的水印设计，以保障生成图像的来源可信度。
